landing.heroSubtitle: The Tunisian platform for barbershop booking and management.

studio.title: QASSA Studio
studio.createDescription: Your shop and owner access are created together. Add your services and barber profiles to get started.
studio.shopSlugHelp: Use lowercase English letters, numbers, and hyphens.
studio.loadError: Your shops could not be loaded. Please try again.
studio.shopSetupDescription: Manage your shop, team, opening hours, and booking availability.
studio.managementLoadError: Shop management data could not be loaded. Please try again.
studio.setupStepDescription: Step {step}. Work through the steps in order; the shop goes live once every required step is complete.
studio.servicesDescription: Set the name, duration, buffer, and price shown to customers. Deactivate services instead of deleting them to preserve appointment history.
studio.noServicesYet: No services yet. Add your first service below.
studio.barbersDescription: Add the barbers customers can book with, then choose which services each barber provides.
studio.noBarbersYet: No barbers yet. Add your first profile below.
studio.createServicesFirst: Add at least one service before assigning services.
studio.websiteDescription: Edit your public details and choose one of five ready-to-use website designs. Save changes, then publish when your services, barber assignments, opening hours, and schedules are ready.
studio.websiteIsPublished: Your website is live and visible in Discover.
studio.websiteIsDraft: Your website is private until you publish it.

requirements.services: Add at least one active service.
requirements.barber_services: Assign an active service to at least one active barber.
requirements.barber_schedules: Set working hours for at least one active barber.
requirements.shop_media: Add at least 3 photos of the salon.
requirements.rest_day: Choose the shop's weekly rest day.

studio.shopHoursDescription: Set the times customers can book at your shop. Times use Tunisia local time. Add multiple periods for split shifts.
studio.noShopHoursYet: Opening hours have not been set yet.
studio.barberScheduleDescription: Set each barber's working periods. A bookable time must fit both the shop opening hours and the barber's schedule.
studio.createBarberFirst: Add a barber profile before setting schedules.
studio.availabilityExceptionsDescription: Unavailable periods are removed from online booking. The weekly rest day is set with the opening hours. Times use Tunisia local time.
studio.barberBreaksDescription: Add recurring breaks that prevent bookings during those times.
studio.barberTimeOffDescription: Block individual dates or date ranges for a barber.
studio.restDayDescription: By Tunisian law the shop closes one weekday every week. Customers see that day as closed and cannot book it.
studio.appointmentsDescription: Review recent and upcoming bookings and update their status.
studio.noAppointments: No appointments in the last 30 days or upcoming.
